name: @kanzo-tech/fixtures
description: The test fixtures: the Nobel laureates, OpenFlights and LDBC SNB, each a sample of the dataset, and a toy graph small enough to count by hand, written to a GraphAr graph by fossil's executor and checked in, and the door that attaches one to a real DuckDB-WASM in Node with @kanzo-tech/graphar-duckdb's attachGraph. Never published.
//dependencies: What the door needs at test time, and nothing of the writer's: `write.mjs` runs fossil through `docs/scripts/write-corpus.mjs`, the one writer, whose `@fossil-lang/executor` is the docs' dev dependency. `@duckdb/duckdb-wasm` is the engine's pin, the one every package's tests run on; `@kanzo-tech/graphar-duckdb` is the attach a page makes, so a test reads what a page reads.
